summary: One node of a violet-tree; child violet-tree-item elements make it a branch.

usage.text: The label goes in the default slot. Child violet-tree-item elements become its branch and are moved to the item slot automatically; do not set that slot yourself.
Clicking the chevron toggles the branch; clicking elsewhere on the row selects the item. Both work only inside violet-tree, which handles its select-request and toggle-request events.
For a branch whose children load later, set expandable, then append the child items when the tree fires expanded-change for it.
value falls back to the label text for selection and event details. expanded and selected can be set in markup for the initial state.
A disabled item cannot be selected or toggled by click but stays in arrow-key navigation.

a11y.text: Its label is the default-slot text. For an item with no text, set aria-label on violet-tree-item; value then falls back to it as well.
